summary_en: 350,000 shares (5.25% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-06 at ¥1,995/share (closing price 2026-08-05), upper limit ¥698.25M. Execution window: single order window 08:45 JST. Stated reason: shareholder returns expansion and capital efficiency improvement.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Techno Medica announced on 2026-08-05 that its board approved a single-day treasury share acquisition of up to 350,000 shares via ToSTNeT-3 off-auction trading on 2026-08-06 at 08:45 JST. The purchase price is ¥1,995 per share (the closing price of 2026-08-05), with an upper limit of ¥698.25M. This represents 5.25% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury denominator: 6,661,602 shares as of 2026-06-30). The stated rationale is expansion of shareholder returns and improvement of capital efficiency. The purchase order is valid only for the specified trading window, with no modification to other trading methods or times. Results will be disclosed immediately after the close of trading on 2026-08-06.
